speaker: thomas_morley
text: Come up. Lenten viols, and a few Italian airs. The lane is no place for either, and the wind has had the kennel all evening.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have the time I came with. I am not bringing a part to sing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: This is the window. On Twelfth Eve I stood under it and heard a pavan, and I did not know the house. I know it now because you asked me in.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: Then you stood in the cold for my coal-smoke, and tonight you may stand in the warm for the same music. Sit. You are not required to know the room, and the room is not required to know you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are suited. I am not asking anyone's name.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: Five voices. The balletts are at the printer's this year. Five, and not a noise for a yard. Give me vowels a singer can open his throat upon. Your English strengths chew like gravel.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Five I can hear. I have no word to offer them tonight, gravel or open.

speaker: (a man of the parish)
text: The Italian one, Master Morley, if the virginals will have it.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: They will have it. I do not sell a name across a candle, and I am not about to start.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: There. Exact. The hand has it before the rest of us have found the time.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: You hear that? She takes the turn a hair late on purpose. She'll never tell you why.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know the hand. I am not saying from where. Do not make us known.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: I am not making you known. What passes is the music, and that is the whole of it. The strings are at a price no player could pay. I will not say the sum. The hour is insult enough if I do.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then leave the sum. Five voices, and the hour you offered. I can go with those, and with the second time through.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: The second time is hers, not mine. I keep a room. A man who paid for those strings would have no supper, and I have already declined to price his hunger.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not writing anything down in this room. Nothing has passed but the music.

speaker: (a man of the parish)
text: Once more, if she will. The fast way. I am not asking who she is.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: If the hand will, it will. I do not command it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep the name where it is. I have the sound. That is the visit.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: You will not be introduced on the stair either. If you pass in the parish, you pass. A printer and a parish are not the same bill.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will know five voices when I see them on a title. Tonight I am not buying strings, and I am not buying a name.

speaker: (a man of the parish)
text: A short room is a Lenten room. I am for the lane.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: Go, in whichever order the stair allows. The viols are done. Come again when you are back, and do not bring me a price to argue.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There was no price, and there was no name. Good night.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: Good night. The lane can invent nothing we did not say, if we did not say it.
